jobs.description:
**Job Title: Customer Support Executive** 

**About the Company**   
***Kanakkupillai*** **(Govche India Private Limited)** is a Chennai\-based, technology\-driven business consulting and professional services firm. We support startups, SMEs, and growing enterprises by simplifying their legal, financial, and compliance requirements. Our team comprises experienced Chartered Accountants, Company Secretaries, Corporate Lawyers, and Business Advisors who deliver reliable and timely solutions. Our services include business registration and incorporation, GST and Income Tax services, accounting and bookkeeping, payroll management, trademark and intellectual property services, and ongoing statutory and regulatory compliance. With a strong focus on quality, transparency, and customer satisfaction, we help businesses stay compliant and achieve sustainable growth.

**Job Summary**   
We are looking for a Customer Support Executive to manage inbound and outbound customer interactions and ensure timely resolution of queries through calls, emails, and chat support. The role focuses on delivering excellent service to business customers while maintaining high customer satisfaction levels within defined turnaround times (TATs).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle inbound and outbound calls professionally and efficiently
* Resolve customer queries via calls, emails, and chat support
* Ensure customer satisfaction by providing accurate and timely solutions within defined TATs
* Understand business customer requirements and address their concerns effectively
* Maintain proper documentation of customer interactions and resolutions
* Adhere to company processes, quality standards, and communication guidelines
* Escalate unresolved issues to the concerned teams and follow up until closure

**Skills \& Requirements** 

* Good communication skills in English and Tamil
* Strong problem\-solving and customer\-handling skills
* Ability to manage multiple communication channels (calls, emails, and chat)
* Customer\-centric mindset with a focus on service excellence
* Basic computer knowledge; familiarity with CRM systems is preferred
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and meet defined TATs

**Experience** 

* 0–3 years of experience in customer support or a similar role
* Freshers with strong communication skills are encouraged to apply

How to Apply Interested candidates can share their resume at hinduja@kanakkupillai.com or contact 7305048933\.

Job Types: Full\-time, Fresher

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹25,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Business Development Executive (BDE) – Fresher

**Company Name:** AMSOL IT Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Title:** Business Development Executive (BDE)  
**Experience:** Freshers (0–1 Year)  
**Salary:** ₹10,000 – ₹20,000 per month (based on skills and performance)  
**Employment Type:** Internship / Full\-Time Opportunity  
**Work Mode:** Hybrid  
**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu

1\. About the Company

AMSOL IT Pvt. Ltd. is a software product\-based company focused on developing innovative software solutions and digital products. We help businesses improve their operations through technology\-driven solutions.

2\. Job Overview

We are looking for motivated, confident and enthusiastic freshers to join our Business Development team. The selected candidates will be responsible for identifying potential customers, generating business leads, understanding client requirements and promoting our software products and services.

This role is suitable for candidates interested in sales, business development, client communication and the IT industry.

3\. Roles \& Responsibilities

**Lead Generation \& Market Research**

* Identify and research potential clients and businesses.
* Generate qualified leads through LinkedIn, Google, business directories and other platforms.
* Research target industries and identify business opportunities.
* Maintain and update lead databases in Excel or Google Sheets.

**Business Development \& Sales**

* Understand the company's software products and services.
* Identify potential customers and introduce suitable software solutions.
* Conduct initial client outreach through calls, emails, LinkedIn and other communication channels.
* Explain product features, benefits and business value to prospective customers.
* Schedule meetings and product demonstrations with interested clients.
* Follow up with prospects and maintain regular communication.

**Client Relationship Management**

* Understand customer requirements and business challenges.
* Build professional relationships with potential clients.
* Coordinate with internal teams for client discussions and product demonstrations.
* Maintain records of client interactions and follow\-up activities.

**Reporting \& Performance Tracking**

* Prepare daily lead generation and activity reports.
* Maintain prospect details and sales pipeline records.
* Track follow\-ups, meetings and lead conversion progress.
* Work towards assigned business development targets.

4\. Required Skills

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of sales and business development.
* Confidence in speaking with clients and handling business discussions.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets.
* Familiarity with LinkedIn and online research.
* Good negotiation, presentation and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to learn software products and explain their benefits.
* Positive attitude, self\-motivation and willingness to achieve targets.

5\. Educational Qualifications

* Any undergraduate or postgraduate degree.
* Freshers from any educational background can apply.
* Candidates interested in sales, marketing and IT business development are encouraged to apply.
* Previous sales experience or internship experience is an added advantage.

6\. Performance Expectations

* Generate relevant and qualified business leads.
* Maintain accurate lead and customer information.
* Conduct consistent prospect outreach and follow\-ups.
* Schedule potential client meetings and product demonstrations.
* Develop a clear understanding of company products.
* Achieve assigned weekly and monthly business development targets.

7\. Salary \& Career Growth

**Monthly Salary: ₹10,000 – ₹20,000**

Salary will be based on the candidate's communication skills, practical knowledge and performance.

* Performance\-based incentives, as per company policy.
* Opportunity to work on real\-time SaaS and software product sales.
* Hands\-on experience in B2B and B2C business development.
* Career growth opportunities based on performance.
* Opportunity to develop sales, negotiation and client management skills.

8\. Selection Process

* Resume Screening.
* HR Interview.
* Communication and Sales Skills Assessment.
* Practical Lead Generation Task.
* Final Interview and Selection.

9\. How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their updated resumes with the HR team.

**Start your career in IT Business Development and grow with AMSOL IT Pvt. Ltd.**

**Eligibility:** B.E / B.Tech / BCA / MCA / B.Sc (Computer Science / IT) / Any Degree with a strong passion for Generative AI and Emerging Technologies


**Skills (Preferred):** Understanding of LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini), Prompt Engineering Techniques, Python Basics, API Integration, Problem Solving, Critical Thinking


#### **Internship Overview**


This internship offers practical exposure to generative artificial intelligence, large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering patterns, and AI\-powered workflow automation. Interns will design and test prompts, explore AI development tools, and build intelligent practical applications.


#### **Available Areas**


* Prompt Engineering \& Prompt Optimization
* Generative AI Tools \& LLM Applications
* AI Workflow Automation \& Agent Architecture
* System Instructions \& Context Engineering
* Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) Concepts
* AI\-Driven Content \& Code Generation
* Custom GPTs \& Conversational AI Bots
* AI Evaluation, Benchmarking \& Safety Guardrails

#### **Responsibilities**


* Design, evaluate, and optimize prompts for complex use cases.
* Build and test automated AI workflows and prototype agents.
* Benchmark and document model response accuracy and reliability.
* Research modern LLM architectures, APIs, and AI developer tools.
* Deliver project documentation and functional demonstration.

#### **Evaluation Parameters**


* Prompt Engineering Precision \& Logic
* Technical Understanding of Generative AI
* Innovation \& Problem Solving
* Documentation \& Reporting Quality
* Practical Project Demonstration
* Professionalism

#### **Important Notes**


* Internship is project\-based.
* Interns will explore state\-of\-the\-art generative AI and prompt techniques.
* Ethical AI principles and responsible use of AI must be adhered to.
* Internship Completion Certificate will be issued after successful evaluation.
